cli.hub_shared_help.publish_yes: Skip the confirmation prompts; does not accept unresolved values (use --accept-unresolved for those)
cli.hub_shared_help.publish_preview_only: Run the preview and print the diff without publishing (exit 2 when it would generalize something)
cli.hub_shared_help.publish_json: Machine-readable preview output; it carries the reference values and the single-use commit pin, so treat it as sensitive
cli.hub_shared_help.publish_accept_unres: Acknowledge every value the preview could not classify, publishing them as-is
cli.hub_shared_help.publish_allow_intern: Consent to the internal-operations allowance for an organization publish (requires --org; shows the consent text interactively)
cli.hub_shared_help.sync_check: Only report what is available; change nothing
cli.hub_shared_help.sync_prefer: Decide a conflict: keep your side or take the hub's for the sections both changed
cli.hub_shared_help.sync_accept_unknown_: Apply when the baseline is unknown: hub additions are taken, nothing of yours goes
cli.hub_shared_help.sync_replace: DISCARD your copy for the hub's (echoes what it discarded; needs --yes)
cli.hub_shared_help.sync_dry_run: Show what would change; write no agent rows
